decision.reason: Remove the unused cross-category pivotal-functor generalization, specialize the API to Kirby-colour encircling inside one premodular category, and keep the five genuine graphical obligations exposed.

exposed_obligations.meaning: Construct the canonical forward insertion context for each simple label y.
exposed_obligations.lean_target_summary: (y : S) -> Context C (fixed tensor dualSimple y) (fixed tensor dualSimple y) (fixed tensor strand) (fixed tensor strand)

exposed_obligations.meaning: Construct the canonical backward insertion context for each simple label z.
exposed_obligations.lean_target_summary: (z : S) -> Context C (dualSimple z tensor fixed) (dualSimple z tensor fixed) (fixed tensor strand) (fixed tensor strand)

exposed_obligations.meaning: Construct the explicit intermediate ribbon diagram after the braiding step for every fusion channel.
exposed_obligations.lean_target_summary: (y z : S) -> EncirclingChannelIndex data x y z -> Diagram C (fixed tensor strand) (fixed tensor strand)

exposed_obligations.meaning: Construct the graphical movie from the forward projection-inclusion coupon in its canonical context to the braided intermediate channel.
exposed_obligations.lean_target_summary: forall y z i, Movie (forwardContext[y].plug(coupon(forwardProjection >>> forwardInclusion))) (braidedChannel[y,z,i])

exposed_obligations.meaning: Construct the graphical movie from the braided intermediate channel to the mated dual-primal coupon in its canonical backward context.
exposed_obligations.lean_target_summary: forall y z i, Movie (braidedChannel[y,z,i]) (backwardContext[z].plug(coupon(matedDual >>> matedPrimal)))
